headline: Coarse-grained and geometric methods map binding and folding free energy landscapes
label: Binding And Folding Free Energies
summary: Coarse-grained and geometric methods are being benchmarked for binding and folding free energies of ligands, DNA, and protein-DNA complexes.
synthesis: The shared thread is quantitative free energy estimation for biomolecular binding and folding using reduced-resolution or geometric formalisms. The coarse-grained funnel metadynamics preprint (CG-FMD, Martini 3) assesses ligand binding at the buried tubulin colchicine site and reports binding free energy mean absolute errors. The TIS-DNA preprint applies the Three Interaction Site coarse-grained DNA model to map the energy landscape and thermodynamics of DNA hairpin folding. A third preprint uses a streamlined geometric formalism to compute absolute protein-DNA binding free energy for three complexes, reporting near-chemical accuracy. What is new is the emphasis on validated absolute energetics and landscape-level thermodynamics across ligand and nucleic acid systems.
